svg.title: Race effort against duration
svg.desc: Line chart of the share of VO2 reserve the Race preset aims for against moving time. Every level holds 0.88 for the first 30 minutes, then eases off along Riegel's power law with an exponent of 1.09 for a beginner, 1.08 recreational, 1.07 trained and 1.06 elite. At 1 hour the goal is 0.83, 0.84, 0.84 and 0.85; at 2 hours 0.79, 0.79, 0.8 and 0.81; at 4 hours 0.74, 0.75, 0.77 and 0.78, so the slower the runner, the harder the fade.
